branches.west: branches-west.jsonl: 458 branches, 229 games on 120 maps: artifacts/ai-theater-allocation-games (2100000-079), ai-theater-execution-games (2100200-279), ai-theater-hq-games (2100300-379), attack-western. 11 pairs of allocation games are identical (same seeds; the theater weights changed nothing there): the second game of each is left out

Together 106 branches, 53 games on 18 maps: frozen-v87r-independent and frozen-v87r-development attack-eastern (28), heuristic@86 self-play on the same seeds (14 distinct of 28), ai-theater-promotion-check(-final) attack-eastern (11 distinct of 16)

horizons: T0+1 and the end of the game
reuse: The 28 S4.7 branches are not run again: their v86 and v87 rows (artifacts/ai-vp-why/cont/{attacker,defender}) are copied to artifacts/ai-s5/s52/reused with v87 renamed cand. In attack engagements the candidate decides as heuristic@87 (situation.attack is true there; S5.1 found 8 S4.7 attack branches row-identical), and the branch, the dice seeds and the opponent are the same, so a rerun reproduces them. Their result was seen in S4.7 (heuristic@87 - v86: Eastern attacker +0.29 +/- 0.67, Eastern defender +4.14 +/- 1.64), so the estimate without them is reported beside the registered one
continuations: West 458 x 2 variants x 1 dice = 916; East 78 x 2 x 2 = 312; 1,228 in all
measure: margin.vp (own VP - enemy VP of the subject) at the end of the game, cand - v86 on the same branch and dice, dice averaged per branch. VP is the primary measure; margin.objectives, Kill - Loss and margin.outOfTrace at the end are reported, not judged
estimate: (Western attacker + Western defender + Eastern attacker + Eastern defender) / 4: the VP change of one attack pair of an independent batch with 20 Western and 20 Eastern pairs (a pair's VP = (the candidate's attacker effect + its defender effect) / 2). 'all cells equally' of ai-continue-compare.py --by-style --by-role --cluster-by-map; SE cluster-robust over maps
expectedPrecision: from S4.7's variance (single-dice SD 6-7, between branches 2.4-3.2): about 0.48 a Western role, about 1.0 an Eastern role, about 0.39 for the estimate
reading: pass probability at pair SD s in {3.7, 4.5}: P = Phi((estimate - 2.1 s / sqrt(40)) / sqrt(s^2 / 40 + SE^2)), the chance that 40 attack pairs pass mean - 2.1 SE > 0 given the estimate and its uncertainty (sample SD taken as s; 3.7 is the last batch's attack pairs, 4.5 a margin for a larger one)
both >= 0.8: recommend registering the independent batch (S5.3)
otherwise: report to the user with the probabilities; the options are to accept the lower probability, to do S5.4 first, or to stop; both below 0.5: recommend not registering
any style x role cell with mean + 2.1 SE < 0: the candidate is established worse there; fix it before registering
reported: each cell and style, the number of branches whose end rows differ between cand and v86, the estimate without the 28 reused branches, the other measures
limits: Branches start at Game Turn 2: the candidate's Game Turn 1 (first moves, first arrivals) is not in the estimate
Eastern Europe has 18 maps; its half of the estimate is the coarse one

The Western positions come from October 2026 games of the theater-weight experiments against the heuristic of that time, replayed with this engine to their recorded final states; their Game Turn 1 was not played by heuristic@86
28 of the 106 Eastern branches have results seen in S4.7
